title: Smooth compactly supported cutoffs converging pointwise to the indicator of an open set
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let V ⊆ ℝⁿ (= Euclid n) be open. Then there is a sequence (b_j)_{j∈ℕ} of functions b_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ with the following properties. For every j, b_j is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), b_j has compact support, tsupport b_j ⊆ V, and 0 ≤ b_j(y) ≤ 1 for all y. For every y ∈ ℝⁿ, b_j(y) → 1_V(y) as j → ∞, where 1_V is the indicator function of V.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)), IsOpen V → ∃ b : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (b j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (b j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (b j) ⊆ V) ∧ (∀ j y, 0 ≤ b j y ∧ b j y ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ y, Tendsto (fun j => b j y) atTop (𝓝 (V.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y))
